title: Follow a feature from code to runtime checks
summary: Join implementation, documentation and test relationships so the developer can find the concrete code path behind a test result.
benefits: Reveal which functions are reused and which test proves the user-visible behavior.
risks: A workflow link and a test definition have different meanings from a passed run.

evidence.claim: The OBJ/MTL roundtrip links three implementation anchors and references both a smoke test and CI workflow.
